mu_name_from: MuMain loads MODEL_STORM_CROW_GLOVES from Data/Player/GloveMale16.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp:154-157: AccessModel(..., "GloveMale", 16); the set at index 15 is file 16). MU's group 10 number 15.
why_this_one: The Magic Gladiator's own set, skipped with the knight's Tarkan imports (the user, 2026-10-06) and built for him (the user, 2026-10-07: 'Both', the set and the level 220 gate). No helm: MU's gladiator wears none.

stats.note: The item's own row: OpenMU's Season 6 initialiser (0.95d's Armors.cs stops at index 14).
stats.classes_from: magicGladiatorClassLevel 1 and every other class 0 in Season 6; MuMain's item.bmd RequireClass is [0, 0, 0, 1]: his alone.

sheet_from: MuMain/src/bin/Data/Player, decoded with pipeline/decode_texture.py: violet lacquered plate whose .OZT alpha cuts its engraving away (a fifth of each sheet).
sheet_note: Not a cutout: MuMain draws the piece RENDER_CHROME on Chrome02 first and its sheet over it (ZzzObject.cpp:6956-6959), so the cut texels show chrome, not holes. Drawn opaque here, their near-black RGB left in, and game/shine.h's kShineCrow lays the chrome on them (shaders/shine.sh shineCrowAdded).
material_note: painted_steel with the cast grain, as Black Dragon's (ArmorMale17): lacquered plate, MU's paint the look. The islands came out plate_steel, the pipeline's default, and in the studio (2026-10-07) the violet turned polished silver with white blowouts from behind and at dusk; set to painted_steel by hand, as Black Dragon's were.
material_overrides_note: painted_steel's own grain is a blade's, brushed along V; on plate it drew vertical streaks down the legs and the pauldrons (studio, 2026-10-04: the user, 'something wrong with pants'). plate_steel's cast grain instead, the paint left as it is.
effects_note: MuMain's only arm for MODEL_STORM_CROW_* is the chrome pass above; no ItemObjectAttribute glow.
